submission.implementation_notes: Revision 2 of the scenario (thread token): one script that runs as a minting policy for the token and as a spending validator for the funds, and reads its own hash from the script context. The validator body is the one of `Plinth_1.71.0.0_Unisay`, on the decoder of the 1.67 line. Compiled with Plinth 1.67.0.0. Builtin casing needs no flag: 1.67 removed the plugin's `datatypes=BuiltinCasing` option (IntersectMBO/plutus#7859) and the default `SumsOfProducts` enables casing on its own. Requires protocol version 11 (van Rossem), live on mainnet since 2026-07-18. Inliner budgets: `inline-unconditional-growth=16`, `inline-callsite-growth=21`, kept from revision 1 and not swept again. Source: `lib/TwoPartyEscrow.hs` (+ `lib/TwoPartyEscrow/Fixture.hs` and the decoder DSL under `lib/Plinth/`) in plinth-cape-submissions @ 814c7fc0f262e86ea7fd6a45e9e5b3c54d42374f.
